name: Red String Theory
source:
Serena wakes up in a strange place without her memories. When her memories return, she's left with more confusion than answers. Can she escape with her sanity? 

[From [url=https://zedie.itch.io/red-string-theory]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
瑟琳娜在一个陌生的地方醒来，失去了记忆。当她的记忆恢复时，她留下的困惑多于答案。凭借她的理智，她能逃脱吗？

[来自[url=https://zedie.itch.io/red-string-theory]Itch.io[/url]]
